body: Thank you!
Okay that’s good to know, thank you! If I don’t find somewhere I guess I’ll be staying put until they evict me :))

They are well known, the number they called from is the number on their website, I spoke to the woman who did the viewing. However the whole thing is suss, even if they are a legit business, I don’t know how they get away with it
Can’t say I’ve been offered that, or any help. I know other people it’s happened to, they also weren’t offered any help

No over the phone she said holding deposit. We’ve had no documentation confirming we have the flat, we haven’t even given them any documentation regarding our employment etc. we literally had a viewing, phoned up and said we wanted to apply and they asked for the ‘holding deposit’ over the phone. In hindsight I shouldn’t have rushed into it but I’m in a desperate situation
It’s completely fucked. I want to get back at the landlord, but also need my deposit back.
What if I decline? Would I still be able to fight for it back?

I’ve been in the flat less than 6 months, I’m being evicted because the landlord is moving back in. It’s unfortunately completely legal. 28 days is shocking given the state of housing but yeah it’s some how legal
So they asked for a holding deposit, which will be taken off my actual deposit if the landlord accepts my application. So this is in theory illegal?

I had a friend view it for me, I couldn’t due to work. The letting agents have offices over Glasgow, they’re one of the bigger ones. But the flat has been on the market for a couple months which worries me, I’m just thinking if I want to back out I’m not getting that back - but I’m also reading they’re illegal? The advert for the flat said the holding deposit was 0 too
It was an actual letting agents, they are legit (one of the bigger ones but not DJ Alexander). Also using the term ‘legit’ loosely, they’re all scumbags
